meta.description: Default model pricing pack. Coefficients are vendor list prices in USD per million tokens.
meta.provenance: Extracted from a NewAPI v1.0.0-rc.37 instance's synced pricing tables (models.dev / OpenRouter), which reflect public vendor list prices. Facts, not code.

billing_expr.claude-fable-5-1: tier("standard", p * 10 + cr * 0.25 + cc * 12.5 + cc1h * 20 + c * 50)
billing_expr.claude-haiku-4-5: tier("standard", p * 1 + cr * 0.1 + cc * 1.25 + cc1h * 2 + c * 5)
billing_expr.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: tier("base", p * 1 + c * 5 + cr * 0.1 + cc * 1.25 + cc1h * 2)
billing_expr.claude-sonnet-4-5: tier("standard", p * 3 + cr * 0.3 + cc * 3.75 + cc1h * 6 + c * 15)
billing_expr.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929: tier("standard", p * 3 + cr * 0.3 + cc * 3.75 + cc1h * 6 + c * 15)
billing_expr.deepseek-flash: weekday("UTC") >= 1 && weekday("UTC") <= 5 && ((hour("UTC") >= 1 && hour("UTC") < 4) || (hour("UTC") >= 6 && hour("UTC") < 10)) ? tier("peak", p * 0.3 + cr * 0.006 + c * 1.2) : tier("off_peak", p * 0.15 + cr * 0.003 + c * 0.6)
